prerequisites: Theory of Structures and Industrial Constructions (3rd year course)

learning_outcomes.text: Know, understand, and apply the current codes in the field of steel structure design.
Know and use the software for the design and calculation of steel structures used in laboratory practices.
Dimension and verify real elements of metallic structures.
Characterize, dimension, and verify real connections between elements of metallic structures.
Draft and develop projects related to metallic construction.

syllabus_topics: Elements subjected to normal force. Tension. Pillars. Global stability
teaching_methods: Technical visits to companies or construction sites (alternative to lab practices)
assessment_rules: For the ordinary and extraordinary calls, the final grade is calculated as 0.75 * ((0.4 * Theory part) + (0.6 * Problems part)) + 0.25 * (Course Work). Attendance to a minimum of 80% of Laboratory practices is mandatory. Delivery of the proposed course work is a requirement to pass the subject. There is no minimum grade specified for the evaluable elements. For students who did not complete laboratory practices in the extraordinary call, the exam will include a third part on these (PL), and the final grade will be 0.75 * ((0.3 * Theory part) + (0.5 * Problems part) + (0.2 * Lab Practices part)) + 0.25 * (Course Work).
